RE: Jonathan Davis Claim No: WC-8849201-99 DOB: 10/14/1995 Dear Mr. Vance, We are writing to inform you that Liberty Mutual Workers Assurance has requested a peer review of the proposed prosthetic prescription (Myoelectric Transhumeral Prosthesis) submitted by NextStep Prosthetics. Consequently, authorization for physical and occupational therapy utilizing the prosthesis has been put on temporary hold. Please note that a formal treatment gap will occur during this review period. Physical and occupational therapy sessions are suspended effective immediately until authorization is received. 

Sincerely, M. Reyes Recovery Analyst / Patient Accounts

# PROSTHETIC CLINICAL RECORD 

PATIENT Jonathan Davis 

DOB 10/14/1995 

MRN 948-20491-A 

DATE OF SERVICE 02/05/2025 

## SUBJECTIVE 

Patient is present for delivery and initial fitting of his custom Myoelectric Left Transhumeral Prosthesis. He reports that the stump has healed excellently following the neuroma revision by Dr. Vance. No localized focal pain. 

## OBJECTIVE 

Prosthesis delivered: Custom carbon-fiber socket, Utah Myoelectric Elbow, Motion Control MC Hand. Initial electrode calibration performed over the residual biceps and triceps muscle complexes. Patient demonstrated 80% accuracy in firing signals to open/close the hand and flex/extend the elbow. 

## ASSESSMENT 

Successful initial fit. Excellent comfort and suspension. Control signals are clean. 

## PLAN 

Deliver device. Patient to begin intensive physical/occupational therapy at Hope Valley to master operational controls. Follow-up here in 4 weeks. 

## Robert Chen 

Robert Chen, CPO, LPO — Certified Prosthetist-Orthotist NPI 1749201948 Signed 02/05/2025

## SUMMARY OF CARE 

Patient Jonathan Davis has completed his comprehensive rehabilitation program. Over the last 18 months, he has advanced from absolute left-sided immobility to master level operation of his myoelectric upper limb prosthesis. He can independently perform ADLs, drive, and carry up to 25 lbs with the prosthetic device. Left shoulder active range of motion has restored to near normal. Discharged to return to modified light/medium duty at NSK.
